## Type / Tür

## Checklist / Kontrol listesi

- [ ] `npm run build` was run, and generated files (`dist/`, `adapters/`, `catalog.json`, `llms.txt`, `00-index.md`) are committed
- [ ] `npm test` passes (build check + validate + installer round trips)
- [ ] New styles have every field (ID, Origin, DNA, Palette, Type, Layout, Motifs, Do, Don't, CSS/Tailwind, Prompt) and real Google Fonts names
- [ ] Tool paths / platform specs link an official source
- [ ] README.md and README.tr.md updated if user-facing behaviour changed
